role: CI gate: `String(format:` calls with float specifiers (and no integer specifiers) in Views/, Export/ and named narrative generators must pass `locale:`.
toplevel: cd to repo root. SCAN_DIRS Views and Export (missing -> 2); SCAN_FILES CitationQuickView.swift, SessionStorageDiagnostic.swift, AnalysisSummaryGenerator*.swift, CoachReportGenerator*.swift, ScoreDetailBuilder.swift, MorningResultsViewModel.swift (missing -> 2). Python per line: skip lines with debugLog/NSLog/os_log or 'locale:'; FMT single-line `String(format: "...",`; float and not int -> violation line. Non-empty output -> exit 1; else clean. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.

flags.text: VIOLATIONS is captured from Python without -e; if the Python step crashes the variable is empty and the gate prints 'clean'. Multi-line String(format:) calls are not matched.

Header excludes Assistant/ because it 'builds LLM prompts'. But WorkoutTriggerEngine+Rules.swift formats user-facing coaching text with String(format: "%.2f"/"%.0f"/"%+.1f%%") without a locale and puts it in String(localized:) messages (e.g. :70-71). Comma-locale users see '.' decimals, and the gate is clean.
